"Mathematics" or simply "Math" is the study of Quantity [[130]], Transformation [[123]] and Change in Systems [[38]] and Problems [[93]]. Mathematics studies these primary elements diverse applications, purposes and enviornments [[83]]. 

Mathematics is able to measure these elements of change, by the implementation of Units of Measurement [[53]] and Transformations.

Mathematics expresses types of Transformation [[123]] and Change in the form of Symbols [[]] and Quantity expressed as Number [[]] formed the "Language of Mathematics, a Language describing precise change."

Mathematics is a Fundamental Subject [[33]] with implications spanning just about every part of everyday life. From Computers [[18]] to Medical-Applications [[]] to even Chemistry [[91]]
